## Latest XKCD

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# Read the data generated by the targets pipeline
data_path <- "data/xkcd.json"
# Fallback for local dev vs rendered location? 
# Since we flattened structure, data/xkcd.json is at project root.
# Quarto running from root should find it.

if (file.exists(data_path)) {
  data <- jsonlite::read_json(data_path)
} else {
  # Fallback if running from subdirectory or if missing
  if (file.exists("../../data/xkcd.json")) {
     data <- jsonlite::read_json("../../data/xkcd.json")
  } else {
     data <- list(
       title = "Error Loading Data",
       explain_url = "#",
       img = "",
       alt = "Could not find data/xkcd.json"
     )
  }
}

# Function to escape double quotes for HTML attributes
sanitize <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x)) return("")
  gsub('"', '&quot;', x)
}

data$title <- sanitize(data$title)
data$alt <- sanitize(data$alt)
data$img <- sanitize(data$img)
data$explain_url <- sanitize(data$explain_url)
```

<div class="card">
  <div class="card-header">`r data$title`</div>
  <div style="text-align: center; padding: 20px;">
    <a href="`r data$explain_url`" target="_blank" title="`r data$explain_url`">
      <img src="`r data$img`" title="`r data$alt`" style="max-width: 100%; height: auto; cursor: pointer;">
    </a>
  </div>
  <div class="card-footer text-muted">`r data$alt`</div>
</div>

```{=html}
<script>
// Immediately unregister any service workers to fix the "cannot open connection" Shinylive error
if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
  navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations().then(function(registrations) {
    for(let registration of registrations) {
      console.log('Unregistering Service Worker:', registration);
      registration.unregister();
    }
  });
}
</script>
```
